Thanks for the notification, Liam — appreciate the quick heads-up. A few items we need to confirm before we can sign-off on this for any EU production workloads: 

1) Data scope: please confirm exactly which fields are transmitted to EdgeMetric. Your note says "no raw request bodies" — list the field names and whether any hashed identifiers could be re-associated with customer IDs.
2) Residency: you state EU options — is EdgeMetric deployed to EU-only regions for EU customers, and do they have an arrangement to prevent cross-border replication?
3) Encryption / KMS: who controls keys for data at rest for the telemetry store? Is it Streamlyx-managed KMS, customer-managed key (CMK), or EdgeMetric-managed keys?
4) Audit evidence: we requested SOC2 in the attachments — we also need any enclave/escrow attestation for the telemetry pipeline and a short DPIA for the new processor.
5) DPA amendment: please share the DocuSign link for the DPA amendment, and confirm expected turnaround time.

Can you also confirm whether EdgeMetric will ever receive logs that include IP addresses or raw metadata (we need to be conservative here)? If possible attach an "EdgeMetric minimal-impact statement" that enumerates data retention windows and deletion controls.

Monica — thanks, answers below inline.

On Fri, Jul 27, 2028 at 10:03 AM Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai> wrote:
> 1) Data scope: please confirm exactly which fields are transmitted to EdgeMetric.

EdgeMetric receives: timestamp, service_id, event_type, aggregate_metric, hashed_customer_id (SHA-256), sampling_flag. They do NOT receive request payloads, headers beyond routing metadata, or full user identifiers.

> 2) Residency: you state EU options — is EdgeMetric deployed to EU-only regions for EU customers, and do they have an arrangement to prevent cross-border replication?

EdgeMetric runs dedicated EU clusters for EU tenants and we've bound EU customer data to those clusters. Cross-region replication is disabled for telemetry datasets that are marked EU.

> 3) Encryption / KMS: who controls keys for data at rest for the telemetry store?

Streamlyx manages the KMS (AWS KMS CMK) and EdgeMetric uses Streamlyx-stored keys via IAM role assumption. They do not hold their own long-term key material for these stores.

> 4) Audit evidence: we requested SOC2 in the attachments — we also need any enclave/escrow attestation for the telemetry pipeline and a short DPIA for the new processor.

SOC2 summary included in the first email — full report available under NDA. EdgeMetric also provided a short impact statement (attached) and we can produce an HSM attestation if required by Redwood's legal.

> 5) DPA amendment: please share the DocuSign link for the DPA amendment, and confirm expected turnaround time.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/streamlyx/dpa/abc123 (we've queued the DPA amendment for signature; typical turnaround is 2–3 business days once countersigned).

Attachments added: edge-impact-statement.txt (short processor impact statement).

If you need an engineering contact to walk through network flows or provide a packet-level example (sanitized), let me know and I'll schedule.

Cheers,

Monica / team — quick clarifications following your internal review: 

- EdgeMetric will not store IP addresses or raw user identifiers. The hashed_customer_id is derived from customer-provided tenant_id and salted at ingestion. We can provide the salt handling description under NDA if Redwood legal wants to validate non-reversibility.
- Retention: 30 days for raw telemetry, 13 months for aggregated roll-ups used for product analytics (aggregates are non-identifying).
- Escrow/HSM: EdgeMetric has an HSM-backed signing key for code integrity and supports explicit attestation packages; for data keys we rely on Streamlyx's CMK.

If Redwood is comfortable with the above, we can finalize the DPA countersignature and proceed with a staged EU rollout (canary + 2-week validation window). If you'd prefer, we can do a short call with EdgeMetric engineering (30 min) to walk controls and region isolation.

Best,
